def forward(x, W1, b1, W2, b2):
    z1 = x @ W1 + b1
    a1 = np.maximum(0.0, z1)        # ReLU
    z2 = a1 @ W2 + b2
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-z2))  # sigmoid

def loss(y_hat, y):
    eps = 1e-9
    return -np.mean(y * np.log(y_hat + eps) +
                    (1 - y) * np.log(1 - y_hat + eps))
